stall_detection.rule: Record suspicious intervals of sustained native-counter and broad-state stasis while active battle, both HP positive and no known pause/hitstop/cinematic gate. Review the associated video before calling a hang.
avoid_false_positives: No movement or no HP change alone is not a stall.
Counter repeats can occur during native load or frame work; allow repeats and wrap16bit.
A completed round or native scene transition is valid; stop with a labelled tail rather than resetting HP.
AI counters may saturateFF and script cursors may repeat legitimately.
Synthetic incomplete FX fixture left E73C nonzero; that was not evidence of a real-game hang.
stall_detection.verdict_limits: No universal stall-duration threshold was validated. Core return and a changing framebuffer alone do not establish correct game logic.
